title: Community guidelines
body:
Thank you for taking the time to join the conversation. This is an academic learning space, and I want it to be welcoming for students, lecturers, practitioners and curious readers alike.

## How to take part

* **Be respectful.** Disagree with ideas, never with people. Personal attacks, harassment, discrimination or hateful language will be removed.
* **Bring evidence where you can.** Links to reports, papers or data are very welcome. Please say where a claim comes from.
* **Stay on topic.** Comments should relate to the post they're on.
* **Protect privacy.** Don't share personal information about yourself or anyone else.
* **No spam or advertising.** Promotional comments and unrelated links will not be published.
* **Be honest about who you are.** Use your real name or a consistent professional name. Affiliations are optional.

## How moderation works

* Every comment is reviewed before it appears. I aim to review new comments as soon as possible.
* I don't edit what you write. If a comment doesn't meet these guidelines, I'll decline it rather than change it.
* Spam is filtered automatically, and submissions that look automated are discarded.
* Your email address is used only to verify your comment and, if needed, to contact you about it. It is never published.

## Removing a comment

If you'd like a comment you've posted removed, use the [contact form](#/contact) and I'll take it down.

## Academic integrity

Please don't post assignment answers or confidential course material. If you quote something, credit it.
